_comment: In-place text patches applied to upstream files while staging. Each entry lists the upstream path inside the release tarball. The literal token @...@ placeholders are substituted by tools/make_deb.py.

patches.reason: Upstream loads the runtime with ctypes.CDLL('lib/librkllmrt.so'), a path relative to the SDK tree that does not exist once the library is installed system-wide.
Same ctypes CDLL path problem as flask_server.py.
Upstream copies librkllmrt.so and the tuning scripts out of ../../rkllm-runtime and ../../scripts inside the SDK tree.

replacements.replace:
for plat in 3576 3588 rv1126b 3562; do
    cp /usr/bin/rkllm-fix-freq-rk${plat} ./rkllm_server/fix_freq_rk${plat}.sh
done
